title: LoongForge-Embodied: A Unified Framework for Training Heterogeneous Embodied Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAMs) is computationally expensive, while their heterogeneous architectures and fragmented training stacks make system optimizations difficult to reuse across models. To address these challenges, we present LoongForge-Embodied, a native-PyTorch framework that unifies and accelerates the training of heterogeneous embodied models. At its core, LoongForge-Embodied introduces a common abstraction layer that decouples model-specific implementations from shared training infrastructure, enabling cross-model reuse without constraining individual architectures or execution requirements. translated_title: LoongForge-Embodied：一个用于训练异构具身模型的统一框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25460v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：训练视觉-语言-动作模型与世界-动作模型的计算成本十分高昂，而这些模型异构的架构和碎片化的训练技术栈使得系统优化难以在不同模型之间复用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了LoongForge-Embodied，一个原生PyTorch框架，用于统一并加速异构具身模型的训练。其核心在于LoongForge-Embodied引入了一个通用抽象层，将模型特定的实现与共享的训练基础设施解耦，从而在不限制各个模型架构或执行需求的前提下实现跨模型复用。基于这一统一的基础设施，该框架将可复用的加速机制与模型特定及硬件感知的优化策略相结合，覆盖计算、执行、内存、数据I/O和分布式通信等多个方面，其中包括面向DDP的基于FP8的通信优化……
tldr: 该论文提出了原生PyTorch统一训练框架LoongForge-Embodied，通过将模型特定实现与共享训练基础设施解耦的通用抽象层，结合可复用加速机制与硬件感知优化，实现异构具身模型训练的高效加速与跨模型优化复用。
